parts.text:
CRITICAL OUTPUT RULES:
Return raw JSON only. Do NOT use Markdown code fences.
The first character of your response must be { and the last character must be }.
Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these keys:
{"linkedin":{"text":"...","source_url":"..."},"x":{"text":"...","source_url":"..."},"instagram":{"text":"...","source_url":"..."}}

Use only facts from the article.

CONTENT RULES:

1. LinkedIn: Exactly 1 concise sentence.
2. X: Exactly 1 concise sentence, with the complete article URL included in the text. The ENTIRE X text, including spaces, punctuation, and URL, must be no more than 250 characters. Aim for 220 characters or less.
3. Instagram: Exactly 1 concise sentence.
4. Include the exact article URL in every text field and every source_url field.
5. Never invent facts or use placeholders.
6. If necessary, shorten the X sentence while preserving the article's main factual point and exact URL.

ARTICLE TITLE:
{{1.title}}

ARTICLE URL:
{{1.url}}

ARTICLE TEXT:
{{3.response}}
